description: This PHP source file defines the `OAuthRefreshToken` entity class for the OrangeHRM system, representing OAuth 2.0 refresh tokens stored in the database, including properties such as refresh token string, access token, expiry date, and revoke status, along with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: OAuthRefreshToken
classes.description: Entity class representing OAuth 2.0 refresh tokens with properties for token data and methods to access and modify them.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the OAuth refresh token.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the OAuth refresh token.

methods.name: getAccessToken
methods.description: Returns the associated access token string.

methods.name: getExpiryDateTime
methods.description: Returns the expiry date and time as a DateTimeImmutable object, with timezone set to UTC.

methods.name: setExpiryDateTime
methods.description: Sets the expiry date and time.

methods.name: isRevoked
methods.description: Indicates whether the token has been revoked.

methods.name: setRevoked
methods.description: Sets the revoked status of the token.
